name: my-fire-number-hype-video
description: Recreatable hype video for the My Fire # website and apps: storyboard, procedural music, and a frame-accurate renderer.

scripts.shrink: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i ../../metadata/video/my-fire-number-hype.mp4 -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 24 -maxrate 1000k -bufsize 2000k -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac     -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../../metadata/video/my-fire-number-hype-small.mp4
scripts.build: npm run capture && npm run music && npm run render && npm run shrink
